hints.title: Rising edge detection
hints.content: To detect a button press (not a hold), check `currButton && !prevButton`. This is true only on the first loop() where the button transitions from released to pressed. Always update `prevButton = currButton` at the end of loop().

hints.title: Toggling a boolean
hints.content: Use `clawOpen = !clawOpen;` to flip the state. Then use a ternary to pick the servo position: `clawServo.setPosition(clawOpen ? 1.0 : 0.0);`

hints.title: Why not use sleep()?
hints.content: In OpMode, loop() must return quickly. Never call sleep() or blocking loops inside loop() — the robot controller will not be able to update other subsystems. Use state variables and ElapsedTime instead.
